SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT ORD_SHEET_NO AS LEGACY_PO_NO, PMOK_SEQ AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, PMOK_CODE AS BUYER_ITEM_NO FROM RTMRO02 WHERE CONFORM_FLAG = '1'
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'KUKD' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, NVL(A.STATUS,' ') AS STATUS, A.ORD_SHEET_NO AS LEGACY_PO_NO, TO_CHAR(A.PMOK_SEQ,'FM000') AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, NVL(A.PMOK_CODE,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, 'KRW' AS CURRENCY_CODE, NVL(A.BASE_PRICE,0) AS UNIT_PRICE, NVL(A.CONFORM_QTY,0) AS GR_QTY, NVL(A.CONFORM_AMT,0) AS GR_AMT, NVL(A.CONFORM_DATE,' ') AS GR_DATE, NVL(A.BUDGET_DEPT,' ') AS LEGACY_PR_NO, A.ORD_SHEET_NO AS LEGACY_GR_NO, TO_CHAR(A.PMOK_SEQ,'FM000') AS LEGACY_GR_SEQ, NVL(A.ASK_PLACE_CODE,' ') AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, 0 AS RO_QTY, 0 AS RO_AMT, ' ' AS REMARK FROM RTMRO02 A WHERE A.CONFORM_FLAG = '1' AND ORD_SHEET_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND PMOK_SEQ = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND PMOK_CODE = '$G_RS.BUYER_ITEM_NO$' ORDER BY A.ORD_SHEET_NO,A.PMOK_SEQ
UPDATE RTMRO02 SET CONFORM_FLAG = '2' WHERE CONFORM_FLAG = '1' AND ORD_SHEET_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND PMOK_SEQ = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND PMOK_CODE = '$G_RS.BUYER_ITEM_NO$'
